prose: The Information reports OpenAI has expanded ChatGPT ads to 26 additional countries, taking the total to 83, and says its advertiser base has grown past 100,000, up from 20,000 in August. The article is paywalled and could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline.
highlights: ChatGPT ads expand to 26 more countries, 83 total
Advertiser base tops 100K, up from 20K in August
Source: Alix Coutures, The Information, via Techmeme
basis: Basis: Techmeme headline only; The Information is paywalled and the fetch returned an error.
